cases.name: direct annotation

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: explicit conversion

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:any=(raw:=C);String(c===raw)+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: ordinary constructor annotated elision

steps.source: class C{}const c:C=new C();const raw:any=c;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: inherited link

steps.source: class C{}class D extends C{}const raw:any=Object.create(D.prototype);const c:C=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(D.prototype,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: pure membership

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const before=raw is C;String(before)+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: union membership does not pin selected class

steps.source: class C{}class D{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C|D=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,D.prototype))+"/"+String(raw is D);

cases.name: valid replacement dependencies

steps.source: class C{}const old:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const raw:any=Object.create(old);const c:C=raw;const next:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const a=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,next);const b=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(old,null);const d=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(next,null);String(a)+"/"+String(b)+"/"+String(d)+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: Object setPrototypeOf throws before mutation

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;let error="none";try{Object.setPrototypeOf(raw,null);}catch(e){error=e.name;}error+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: forwarding proxy alias

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;const p:any=new Proxy(raw,{});String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(p,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: target prototype outgoing link irrelevant

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(C.prototype,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: parameter before body

steps.source: class C{}let entered=0;function f(v:C){entered++;return Reflect.setPrototypeOf(v,null);}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);String(f(raw))+"/"+entered+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: return before caller mutation

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);function f():C{return raw;}const c:any=f();String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(c,null))+"/"+String(c is C);

cases.name: converting constructor result

steps.source: class C{constructor(v:any){}}const raw:any=1;const c:any=(function f(v:any):C{return v;})(raw);String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(c,null))+"/"+String(c is C);

cases.name: legacy proto setter refuses invalidation

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;let error="none";try{raw.__proto__=null;}catch(e){error=e.name;}error+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: shared chain remains constrained by another instance

steps.source: class C{}const shared:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const a:any=Object.create(shared);const b:any=Object.create(shared);const ca:C=a;const cb:C=b;const x=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(a,C.prototype);const y=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(shared,null);const z=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(b,C.prototype);const w=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(shared,null);[x,y,z,w,a is C,b is C].join(",");

cases.name: all acquired class obligations survive a prototype update

steps.source: class B{}class D extends B{}const raw:any=Object.create(D.prototype);const b:B=raw;const d:D=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,B.prototype))+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(D.prototype,null))+"/"+String(raw is D)+"/"+String(raw is B);

cases.name: failed plan leaves previous links guarded

steps.source: class C{}const link:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const raw:any=Object.create(link);const c:C=raw;const bad:any={};String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,bad))+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(link,null))+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(bad,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: unchanged prototype succeeds on a nonextensible value

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;Object.preventExtensions(raw);String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,C.prototype))+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: introducing an observable prototype is refused without calling its trap

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;let calls=0;const p:any=new Proxy({}, {getPrototypeOf(){calls++;return C.prototype;}});String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,p))+"/"+calls+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: a proxy trap cannot forward an invalidating write

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;let calls=0;const p:any=new Proxy(raw,{setPrototypeOf(target,proto){calls++;return Reflect.setPrototypeOf(target,proto);}});String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(p,null))+"/"+calls+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: a proxy trap reporting success without mutation leaves the target valid

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;const p:any=new Proxy(raw,{setPrototypeOf(){return true;}});String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(p,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: failed constructor conversion retains effects but no invalid nominal result

steps.source: let calls=0;let leaked:any;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;leaked={};return leaked;}}const raw:any=1;let error="none";try{const c:C=raw;}catch(e){error=e.name;}error+"/"+calls+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(leaked,null));

cases.name: constructor abrupt completion retains precedence

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;throw new RangeError("constructor");}}const raw:any=1;let error="none";try{const c:C=raw;}catch(e){error=e.name;}error+"/"+calls;

cases.name: constructor mutation of its own result cannot publish a nonmember

steps.source: let leaked:any;class C{constructor(v:any){leaked=this;Object.setPrototypeOf(this,null);}}const raw:any=1;let error="none";try{const c:C=raw;}catch(e){error=e.name;}error+"/"+String(leaked is C)+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(leaked,C.prototype));

cases.name: an independent completed class boundary survives a later throw

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);function f(v:C){throw new RangeError("later");}try{f(raw);}catch(e){}String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: repeated admission neither releases nor broadens the obligation

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const a:C=raw;const b:C=raw;const c:any=(raw:=C);String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(c===raw);

cases.name: unrelated prototype changes remain ordinary

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;const other:any={};String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(other,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);

cases.name: a valid change does not invalidate an element reference

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;const items:any=[c];let ref p=items[0];const link:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const changed=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,link);String(changed)+"/"+String(p===raw)+"/"+String(p is C);

cases.name: an invalid change leaves a reference and its value intact

steps.source: class C{}const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;const items:any=[c];let ref p=items[0];const changed=Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null);String(changed)+"/"+String(p===raw)+"/"+String(p is C);

cases.name: primitive values returned from constructors use the constructed receiver

steps.source: class C{constructor(v:any){return 1;}}const raw:any=2;const c:C=raw;const x:any=c;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(x,null))+"/"+String(x is C);

cases.name: class expression exact boundary retains constructor identity

steps.source: const C=class{};const raw:any=Object.create(C.prototype);const c:C=raw;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(raw,null))+"/"+String(raw is C);
